title: Reverse Substrings Between Each Pair Of Parentheses
description: Reverse the strings in each pair of parentheses, starting from the innermost one.
pseudocode:
1: stack = [[]]
2: for char in s:
3:   if char == '(': stack.push([])
4:   else if char == ')':
5:     sub = stack.pop().reverse()
6:     stack[stack.length - 1].push(...sub)
7:   else: stack[stack.length - 1].push(char)

steps.note: Initialize stack with an empty array to hold the current level
Push new array to stack for nested level
Found ')', popping and reversing nested level
Append reversed segment to outer stack
